plugins.name: snyk-onboard
plugins.description: Onboard a GitHub repo or a whole org to Snyk: detect each repo's tech stack, pick the Snyk products that fit (Open Source, Code, Container, IaC), import the repos into a Snyk org and open a PR per repo with a .snyk policy and a stack-specific GitHub Actions workflow; checks for the Snyk MCP server and asks before installing it. Plans first and writes nothing until you approve. Supports --dry-run.

plugins.name: create-repo
plugins.description: Create demo GitHub repos for Snyk testing. Default: 2 Go repos (snyk-demo-go-N), one with cross-org go.mod deps on deps-01 and one with public deps only, each with a CI workflow calling brightsheets/reusable-workflows. Also copies of Snyk's nodejs-goof / java-goof. Plans first and creates nothing until you approve.
